headline: Local Food Inspector Denied Entry To His Own Kitchen After Failing To Present Valid 'Sovereignty License'
body:
An inspector from the municipal food safety department was left stranded on his own welcome mat Tuesday evening after his spouse invoked a ‘home-sovereignty’ clause, demanding a certified inspection permit and a 42-page hygiene compliance report before allowing him access to the refrigerator.

“I’ve spent fifteen years shutting down restaurants for using an extra gram of turmeric, but I didn’t realize I was living under a jurisdictional regime that treats a sandwich shop with more judicial leniency than my own pantry,” said the inspector, while waiting in his driveway for a court-appointed mediator to verify the state of the leftover pulao. 

Legal experts suggest this domestic standoff is part of a growing trend where citizens, emboldened by recent high-court reprimands against regulatory overreach, have begun treating their dining tables like independent republics. The inspector’s wife maintained that until he provided a stamped affidavit clarifying the exact shelf-life of the milk carton, the kitchen remained a sovereign entity beyond the purview of any municipal body.
caption: When you accidentally treat your marriage like a bureaucratic inspection and get served a taste of your own medicine. Has your household turned into a sovereign republic yet? #FoodSafety #DomesticDiplomacy #JudgeSaysSo (satire)
igHook: Would you require a permit from your partner to open the fridge?
